# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the verbs: watch, stand, act, be strong. Every one of them demands a decision. No one drifts into strength. No one stumbles into vigilance. These are choices made before the sun comes up, before the excuses have time to form.

As men of God, we face a culture that rewards comfort and calls passivity "peace." But Scripture calls us to something higher. Standing firm doesn't mean you never feel weak—it means you refuse to retreat when weakness shows up. Faith is not the absence of fear; it's the decision to act in spite of it.

You were not made to coast. You were made to contend—for your family, your integrity, your witness, and your walk with Christ. The battle is real, but so is the One who fights beside you. So lace up. Show up. Stand firm today, not because you're the strongest man in the room, but because you serve the God who is.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, pausing between sets to thank God for the strength He gives you. Then text one brother in Christ and ask how you can pray for him today.
